desc:
• CLASSIC COOKIE MIX: Create double chocolate chunk cookies for the whole family to enjoy (Do not eat raw cookie dough)

  • QUICK AND EASY: Just mix, drop, and bake for a chewy, delicious treat any time of the day or night

  • ENDLESS OPTIONS: Prepare cookie mix as is or explore Betty Crocker recipes for a new take on this classic

  • DOUBLE CHOCOLATE GOODNESS: Bite into sweet oven-baked double chocolate chunk cookies

  • CONTAINS: One 17.5 oz pouch of Betty Crocker Double Chocolate Chuk Cookie Mix
features:
Features

Double chocolate goodness: Made with rich cocoa and loaded with real chocolate chunks for an extra indulgent treat.

Quick and easy prep: Just add butter, water, and an egg. Mix, drop, bake—and enjoy fresh cookies in under 20 minutes.

Yields a full batch: Each pouch makes approximately 22–24 regular-sized cookies.

No artificial flavors or colors: Free from high-fructose corn syrup and artificial additives.

Kosher dairy certified: Suitable for those who follow kosher dairy guidelines.

From a trusted brand: Backed by Betty Crocker’s long-standing tradition of reliable, great-tasting baking products. 

Benefits

Perfect for chocolate lovers: Satisfies cravings with a rich, double-chocolate punch in every bite.

Convenient dessert option: Ideal for last-minute baking, parties, or spontaneous sweet cravings.

Customizable treat: Can be personalized by adding nuts, candies, white chocolate chips, or sprinkles.

Foolproof results: Delivers soft, chewy cookies every time—great for beginner bakers or busy households.

Budget-friendly: One pouch serves the whole family or guests without needing multiple baking ingredients.
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Chocolate Chunks (sugar, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, natural flavor), Sugar, Brown Sugar, Palm Oil, Cocoa Processed with Alkali, Leavening (baking soda, sodium aluminum phosphate), Salt, Nonfat Milk.
